turns.text: On 1 October 2026, the net revenue was **€1,124.18** (gross revenue of €1,141.68 minus €17.50 in returns).

args.sql:
WITH orders_sum AS
  (SELECT order_date,
          SUM(amount) AS gross_revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.orders`
   WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-01'
   GROUP BY order_date),
     returns_sum AS
  (SELECT return_date,
          SUM(amount) AS returns_amount
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.returns`
   WHERE return_date = DATE '2026-10-01'
   GROUP BY return_date)
SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' AS sales_date,
       COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) AS gross_revenue,
       COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS returns_amount,
       COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS net_revenue
FROM orders_sum o
FULL OUTER JOIN returns_sum r ON o.order_date = r.return_date;

turns.text: The combined net revenue for 1 and 2 October 2026 is **€1,825.59** (gross revenue of €1,850.34 minus returns of €24.75).
